scope: Local implementation in ce6c/BibleLens of approved D1–D17 and D2 mapping. Existing review evidence and both stashes preserved.

sourceComparison.github: Fetched origin/main; its src/ and worker/ match the review baseline before these edits.
sourceComparison.live: Existing public release is build 242; this checkout is build 241. No synchronization or release is claimed.
sourceComparison.preview: Edited HTML/CSS/JS served directly, with an already-existing build 241 bundle supplying unchanged modules and read-only data. No bundle was created. Preview release/account responses are clearly local fixtures. Chat success/error are browser fixtures.

implemented.D1: Shared plain assessment and biography surfaces; retained Chat and section-introduction roles.
implemented.D2: Compact standalone profile/directory/commandment/prophecy/story references; Timeline text links; inline prose links; existing destinations and previews retained.
implemented.D3: References above italic quotation wording, paired prophecy layout retained, commentary/chronology roles retained.
implemented.D4: 48px search pills with magnifiers and 16px text; Chat composer and send action.
implemented.D5\u2013D6: Compact category-colored quick and panel pills; brighter selection; no added check indicators; measured phone targets.
implemented.D7: Standalone related navigation retained; underlined prose links, no inline pin glyphs; quieter noninteractive badges.
implemented.D8: Compact dropdowns/grids/steps and heading cue. Book-cell merge is gated by merge-picker-inputs in app.js/style.css; remove that class to revert its styling independently, retaining source radio/label roles and data.
implemented.D9: Compact tabs, 20px verse action icons; original On/Off switch and text-size percentage retained.
implemented.D10: Shared disclosure/inspection controls; one click on expand buttons; existing optional double-tap and Enter/Space retained. Commandment catalogue contents are always visible.
implemented.D11\u2013D12: Ribbon Bookmark, chain-link Copy link, overlapping-paper Copy text; consistent close/floating/navigation icons and phone targets.
implemented.D13: Sans serif note editors/title fields, 12px corners, original save flow and native file chooser retained.
implemented.D14: 24px plain panels; desktop centering and phone bottom sheets; 18px verse previews; taller map and closer starting zoom.
implemented.D15: 22px category-tinted cards and sans serif headings; quieter inner sections; Chat tails and three-dot thinking state.
implemented.D16: Blue 2px focus rings with 2px gap; whole-field search/composer focus while typing.
implemented.D17: Five steps per slider (0/5/10/15/20), defaults 10/15, no visible setting values, one reset icon beside Base opacity. Device-local persistence separate from notes/sync revisions. Plain tint/gradient only, opaque text.

map.source: Natural Earth 5.1.2 1:50m land and lakes, public domain; retained Theographic English place names and coordinates. Geometry unchanged.
map.limitations: Generalized modern outlines are contextual, not ancient geography. No streets, terrain, elevations, paid provider, signup, or online tiles. Inland views can be sparse at starting zoom 13; zoom out for regional context. Source attribution and historical uncertainty remain.
map.resize: Pin containment checked after map reopen and desktop-to-phone resize.

verification.textScale: 100% main matrix; additional Story wrapping at 115% on phone.

textContrast.method: Text fill temporarily hidden, backgrounds captured at representative text positions, computed text color/ancestor opacity composited against captured pixels; default and maximum tint. Finite visible samples, not every possible content state.

verification.keyboard: Arrow-key native radios; profile arrows/Home; Settings Escape focus return; whole-field composer focus while typing; range step/reset/reload; Chat success/error clears dots and preserves failed question.
verification.phoneKeyboard: Editor at 375×560 reduced viewport with Save reachable; actual native keyboard untested.
verification.fullSuite: npm run check stops at missing dist/server/index.js. Some other scripts require absent test dependencies. One existing verse-role test invokes a build guard internally and failed dependency resolution before producing any bundle; not rerun. No application build output was generated. Syntax checks and git diff --check pass.
verification.standaloneLinks: The only below-size anchor in the main snapshots was the offscreen keyboard-only skip link (41px). It was then raised to 44px and checked separately by keyboard with a screenshot. Other measured standalone anchors met 44px; prose links keep text geometry by owner instruction.
verification.keyboardSkipLink: Final isolated keyboard check confirms 44px focus target; screenshot keyboard-skip-focus-375.png.

unverified: Built web/native integration and complete build-dependent check suite (build forbidden).
Actual iPhone keyboard, gestures and signed app assets.
Every possible content wrap, transient state and opacity combination.
prohibitedActions: No release bundle created, publication, installation, commit, or push. No existing owner notes/bookmarks/account state touched. Both stashes retained.

typographyCorrection.ownerInstruction: No serif anywhere in the project by default.
typographyCorrection.implementation: All default CSS serif stacks and the legacy serif variable replaced with the shared Inter/system sans serif stack. Explicit reader font choices remain opt-in. Standing rule recorded in AGENTS.md.
typographyCorrection.verification: Browser computed-style checks on source markup and representative samples in dark/light at 1280px and 375px; reader-font checks passed. See typography-defaults.json.
typographyCorrection.screenshots: Earlier screenshots predate this final default-typography correction.
